Hassan was awesome great first time experience. Great food. Small shop but perfect ! My husband used to go when he was little w his family now we have brought our son!
If you haven’t gone GO!

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Rosa Johnson
reviewSamples.text: Great bakery with amazing and delicious daily baked products.  I am very fond with their Noon Barbari bread, their spinach cheese pies, white pita bread and whole wheat pita bread are among my favorites. The owners are very very friendly and welcoming. A great bakery for my wholesome bread hungry belly 😋 …
